description: Native probe mutants. Each must compile in the accepted Geth tree and must fail the oracle in the measured run.

mutants.name: hook_never_installed
mutants.reason: No BLOCKHASH lookup reaches the capsule: native code reads its own chain, so no lookup is recorded and the saved poisoned headers are ignored.

mutants.name: native_lookup_bypass
mutants.reason: Native code receives a fresh native lookup instead of the saved header hash; a capsule with a poisoned parent or ancestor header then imports the block.

mutants.name: block_not_from_capsule
mutants.reason: Native code imports the generated block instead of the saved header and body bytes; a capsule with a poisoned body then imports the block.

mutants.name: retry_asks_source
mutants.reason: A retry builds the items from its source again instead of reading the saved capsule; the poisoned source then conflicts with the sealed capsule.

mutants.name: parent_header_wrong_block
mutants.reason: The parent header, hash and root come from the block before the parent, so they differ from the generated chain and BLOCKHASH(3) is wrong.

mutants.name: ancestor_window_short
mutants.reason: The genesis header, a BLOCKHASH window ancestor known before execution, is left out of the capsule.

mutants.name: header_never_poisoned
mutants.reason: The poisoning instrument is broken for headers: the saved parent and ancestor headers equal native truth, so their poisoned scenarios import the block.

mutants.name: body_never_poisoned
mutants.reason: The poisoning instrument is broken for the body: the saved body equals native truth, so the poisoned body scenario imports the block.
